Hi Emily / Tom —

Thanks for the redlines and the clear asks. After internal review we can accept most of the edits in FinCorp_DPA_redline_v2.docx with one ask on retention. Proposed path:

- Retention: We can agree to a 45-day retention for onboarding/telemetry by default. If FinCorp requires 90 days for specific security investigations we will accept a scoped addendum limited to onboarding logs only (not user content) and limited to an explicit set of event types; that addendum will be timeboxed and include the associated cost/ops impact. We are not able to accept a permanent 90-day blanket retention in the DPA body.
- Subprocessor updates: Redwood will commit to monthly subprocessor snapshots and will provide an ops contact for immediate notification; see contact: security-ops@redwood.com.
- Key management: confirm vendor-managed KMS with HSM backing and rotation schedule included as Exhibit B.

Sign order and logistics:
- We will route via DocuSign in the following order: Redwood VP Legal -> FinCorp Legal -> FinCorp Procurement.
- DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/ctr/abc123
- Attached: Redwood_Final_DPA_for_Signature.pdf (final PDF for e-sign), Signer_Map_Route.csv (pre-fill roles).

Tom / Emily: please confirm the FinCorp signer names/emails and whether you accept the scoped 45/90 addendum approach. Once you confirm we will send the DocuSign envelope (target countersign by 2028-03-24 to meet your procurement window).
